notes.title: Fixed the menu v1.1.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
Patch Notes:

✅ Added: 

▪️ Mouse control options: 

• Invert X axis  

• Invert Y axis  

• Mouse sensitivity setting 

▪️ Motion Blur: On / Off 

▪️ FOV (Field of View) adjustment

🔧 Fixed: 

▪️ Issue with graphics and audio settings resetting 

▪️ Improved settings menu stability

Thanks to everyone who’s playing and leaving feedback!



Let me know if you notice any issues with the new menu features.
